t: This Luceco LED colour changing decorative ceiling light in white offers versatile illumination for various indoor spaces. It features an integrated 18W LED, delivering 1350 lumens, and allows selection between warm white (3000K), cool white (4000K), or daylight white (6500K) colour temperatures, controlled simply via a standard light switch. Its durable polycarbonate construction ensures an IP44 rating, making it an ideal choice for bathroom zone 2 and kitchen installations. The light has a long 25,000 hour life and comes with all necessary fittings for straightforward ceiling mounting.
